correctness.rationale: The exact two-arc Fourier integration, including two resonant limits, is reconstructed in Result Section 3. Uniform block means are proved by periodicity/irrational rotation and Abel summation; four logarithmic shoulders give 4s/pi while all remaining tails are bounded. The small-denominator cancellation identity is exact for integer frequencies. Numerical direct-integral checks are supplementary.

originality.rationale: The closest accessible primary texts assert logarithmic order and give a symmetric example, not the all-kink sharp leading coefficient, rational denominator quantization and irrational coefficient. Targeted indexed research records and literature searches for equivalent formulations produced no covering result. Kahane 1970 remains a material uninspected risk.
residual_risks: Kahane, Séries de Fourier absolument convergentes (1970), Ch. VI §2 was cited in later accessible papers but full text was not inspected; it could contain a stronger two-slope norm asymptotic.
An older unindexed exact summation or equivalent rational/irrational asymptotic may exist; web and indexed research records absence is not a uniqueness proof.
Sanders arXiv:2604.07324 full text was not examined; only its abstract was compared, so it is not asserted to be wholly non-covering.

value.rationale: The exact log coefficient for a natural all-kink family of sharpness witnesses to Kahane-type logarithmic boundary is determined, with a strict rational-denominator hierarchy and an irrational plateau. The precise invariant is absent from inspected order-of-growth results, and could be used to distinguish the spectral cost of rational and irrational phase-kink geometry. This is not an arbitrary parameter slice; it exhausts all kink locations under one fixed-slope normalization.
